title: Reacts Results: Broncos Country in favor of trading for RB by deadline

sources.title: Reacts Results: Broncos Country in favor of trading for RB by deadline
sources.description: As the 6-2 Broncos are looking closer to the contending team we hoped for, a lot of fans are hoping for the team to be active before Tuesday’s trade deadline. And most are looking for the team to add a running back. For the 48% hoping for another running back, there is a lot of […]
